authority: Current Founder-relayed Manager instruction referencing Master20.3; Master not opened

contact.eligible: Currently unpublished fields allowed by existing authoritative contact state
contact.save: Explicit selected delta only, never a full replacement that clears existing fields
contact.emptyEligibleSet: Hide add entry; existing edit/withdraw remain
contact.race: Revalidate eligibility before submission; if a selected field is now published do not silently overwrite; refresh eligible list and explain with existing operation feedback
contact.unavailable: Existing neutral unavailable overrides all content

transition.trigger: Confirmed mutual YES in the continuation flow, NOT initial match creation
transition.retry: Reload authorized read-only destination, never resubmit the private vote
transition.whenDataReady: Direct transition, no forced spinner or delay
transition.blockOrEndRace: Apply actual authorized result; never show stale contact
